name: The Debt Floor
description: One of the earliest prestige neural-dramas produced for the format, The Debt Floor places the subscriber inside the experience of Cassian Obi-Ferreira, a Tier 2 credit arbitration officer who processes debt-bonding applications for a mid-tier corponation and slowly realizes he is the instrument of a system designed to be inescapable. The neural architecture is unusually ethical — the feed does not manufacture satisfaction from acts of institutional compliance, and the moral discomfort Cassian feels is transmitted without editorial softening.
cultural_impact: The Debt Floor is considered the foundational text of ethical neural-feed design, and its de-licensing is cited by independent producers as evidence that the Content Accord is a tool of corponation censorship rather than quality control.
story_hooks: The show's original neural architect is still alive and has never spoken publicly about the de-licensing — and someone has just made them an offer to build a sequel using their original uncompromised methodology

A character experiences The Debt Floor on an underground feed and recognizes the debt-bonding workflow depicted as identical to a current, active program — suggesting the show was based on real internal documentation
The voice actor who performed Cassian has been approached by Axiom Consolidated with a lucrative contract that requires them to sign a retroactive rights agreement covering The Debt Floor
